title: Team System
description: A comprehensive Minecraft team management plugin that allows players to create, join, and manage teams, assign roles, set team permissions, customize team chat, and track team statistics, all with easy-to-use commands.
body:
Team System – Advanced Team Plugin

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

FEATURES

• GUI system with player heads
• Team chat for private communication
• Discord webhooks for all events
• PlaceholderAPI support (6+ placeholders)
• Multi-language (DE/EN)
• Hex color support
• PvP protection (optional)
• Tab completion

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

COMMANDS

/team create <name> – Create a team
/team disband – Disband your team
/team invite <player> – Invite a player
/team accept/deny – Accept or deny an invitation
/team kick <player> – Kick a player
/team leave – Leave your team
/team info – Show team info
/team list – List all teams
/team chat – Toggle team chat
/team gui – Open the GUI

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

PERMISSIONS

teamsystem.create/disband/invite/kick/leave/chat/gui/admin

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

PLACEHOLDERAPI

%teamsystem_team% – Team name
%teamsystem_leader% – Leader name
%teamsystem_members% – Number of members
%teamsystem_max_members% – Max members
%teamsystem_has_team% – Has a team
%teamsystem_is_leader% – Is the leader

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

INSTALLATION

Put the JAR in the plugins folder

Restart the server

Adjust the config (optional)

Set up Discord webhook (optional)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

REQUIREMENTS

• Minecraft 1.21.4
• Spigot/Paper
• PlaceholderAPI
